steps.name: some memory
steps.objective: [Minuet] Check what happened in front of you and go to [Adkina] in the “Valley of the Dragon.”

lines.text: (Adrica arrived at the place following the wind blowing from somewhere. Minuet was standing in front of it with a blank expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, minuet? are you okay?
(No matter how much I sing, the minuet does not respond.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet? What happened? excuse me… .
(Suddenly the field of view is filled with black.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?! This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Same as back then...)
Ugh, keaaaaaa!!
(The sound of someone's pain echoes in an unfamiliar place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

choices.text: 1. Who is it? Whose voice is it?

lines.text: It's painful, it's painful... .
(Little by little, the figure of the person complaining of pain begins to appear in the darkness.)
Ugh… .
Hahaha... .
▒▒, I need to find it… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It has black horns on its head. Could it be a devil?)
The magic stones that humans have cannot be used!!
Ugh, hahaha... .
Who are you? What are you looking at me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that devil not see me? Why can I see?
I've become sensitive... .
Need to fill... .
Otherwise… .
Wow... .
Magic stone, ▒▒ made of magic stone, I have to find it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… …
(There are a lot of black and blue magic stones in front of the boy with sword horns.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A magic stone created by the Deimos Church... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are the magic stones over there?
(The vision becomes blurred again and the devil can no longer be seen.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Now open your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Oh, it's still a minuet. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, are you Gaia?
(Holy light begins to rise around the minuet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's the same as back then. When I turned into Gaia...)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Once again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will wait.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Ah, I guess it will work now... .
(The sacred light rises once again, and the minuet transforms into the image of the goddess Gaia.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It’s been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Gaia.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry for keeping you waiting.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It seems like it's been a long time since I should have fallen asleep, but I still can't fall asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know what I just saw?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Did you just see something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He says he saw a demon boy in the dark with a lot of magic stones from the Deimos Church.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It seems like you've come to see the realm of the demon world... . Maybe it's the influence of the artifact.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say it's a relic... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: The ‘flame of truth’ that Lethe possessed… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Perhaps Lethe wanted to tell me something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lete… , Is Lethe extinct?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Maybe we can meet again when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I say I’m glad… . There were a lot of things I wanted to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Gaia. Can you tell me now? The reason you called me... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: The superhuman strength you and Iris need, there are only three left. One trace... . You can meet it by crossing this Adrika and heading north.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: The road that was sealed by Adkina and Medea has been unlocked at my request and you can now go.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: And before you go, meet Adkina. I'll tell you a story that will help you.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Then I'll just leave. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.
(As the sacred light passes through Gaia, the minuet appears again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes… . Oh, I was sleepy for a moment... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Gaia already told me to sleep whenever I have time... . I'm going to sleep for a while.
(As soon as the words are finished, Minuet falls asleep while standing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I fell asleep very comfortably... . So much so that I want to sleep too... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, then I will go to Adkina. If you go, you'll know what's going on, right?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I was waiting. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s been a while, Adkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia told me about Adkina and someone who could help me, so I came.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Oh, is that so? Gaia... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Okay, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Not long ago, a lot of demons appeared on Phobos. Nothing much happened, but I thought it was necessary to protect the place where people live and the ghosts, so I simply set up a barrier.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I also received help from Medea... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They're demons... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: He knows Phobos well, so I told him about it in advance. The goddess' messenger will soon arrive at Phobos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is that person?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's called Beled. You'll be fighting demons and monsters that appear on Phobos. If you meet him, talk about various things, and find things to do, you will meet the evil king.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Baldrick always appears in Phobos around this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I would like to help you, but I can't because I have work to do in Adrica. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. I'll go to Phobos then.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Please, don't criticize Beled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does it mean to not drive people badly? Think about it later, and let's go to Phobos for now.)
(%s disappears from the Dragon Valley and a wind carrying flower petals blows from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Gaia… .
(Gaia appears where the warm wind passed.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry, Adkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Sorry, Gaia. Last time… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It's not Adkina's fault, so don't worry. It's their fault for invading this place.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Gaia, are you okay? Iris too… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry for putting you through something you didn't want to happen.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm fine. I'm just worried about Gaia... . ah… .
(Gaia approaches Adkina and buries her face in her chest.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Everything will be fine.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes, Gaia.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Just like Ceres, I also do it for this land... .

steps.name: Check your skills
steps.objective: In "Phobos", defeat [Kyuiring the Oblivious] and [Kominam] and report to [Beled].

lines.text: You guys are so tireless. Maybe it's because I don't have the ability to learn.
(A young-looking boy grins and extends his hand towards the running demon and monster. Red light flows from the boy's hand and surrounds the demon and monster.)
Take care of it.
(The eyes of the devil and monsters change and begin to attack each other.)
I know you're there. Don't just watch, come out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I got caught.
I know they came for me because you showed up. Because guys who only have instincts always react to power. Not ordinary power, but special power... .
Come to think of it, are you the one sent by Uncle Adkina?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. Then you Beled… ?
(The boy named Beled grins and shakes his hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you. I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm Beled. I heard your story. My uncle told me to help him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I feel an unknown power at my fingertips...)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: After all, you are different from ordinary humans. People just come naturally fascinated... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm a devil, but I don't care about anything else, so don't worry too much. Because there's only one thing I'm interested in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought something was different, but the devil... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm just different from the devil. I hope you refrain from comparing yourself to stupid things like that.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: So what should we do first?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Helping you is also helping you. I don't even know what your skills are. so… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I need to show you something clear. Catch the stupid things you see over there. If it's your strength, there's no problem, right?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It will be helpful to Peonia if even one of them is reduced.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But who is Peonia?)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll be waiting here. Then try it.

steps.name: Red Land Solver
steps.objective: Defeat [Searching Tracker] and [Elegant Noble Succubus] in "Phobos" and visit [Chrysien] in "Mars".

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: This is the first time I've seen someone like you since I came here. I’ve seen solvers who can fly for a long time, but… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: To defeat demons and monsters like this. After all, it deserves to be called a motherfucker.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Then let me tell you a story. It's no big deal. A lot of demons appear on Phobos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can see that just by looking at it… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I don't know exactly where it appears. I need to figure that out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Am I suspicious? are you okay. It's natural. Because demons and all beings that are foreign to humans have no choice but to be like that.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Still, can I trust you? I like humans. Not as a demon, but just as a being with a self and a soul versus a being.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like there's someone other than just humans... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yeah. Peonia. He's my favorite person. You're going to Mars anyway. Then you will be able to see it naturally.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Haha… , At this point, it would be nice if Peonia just trusted me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .
(Beled’s eyes look somewhat sad.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Keep catching those stupid demons for Peonia. It would be nice if there was a way... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, how do you know Adkina?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: That guy is kind of interesting. You saved me from being exiled and lying on the border between Phobos and Adrica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Expulsion?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: In fact, I was so popular in Rosengarten that the other magicians kicked me out. Look at this beauty!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cute rather than beautiful... . Huh, sorry.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What is it? Don't I look beautiful?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Hehe, Peonia is also Peonia, but you also need the discernment to properly distinguish between cuteness and beauty.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Let me explain about beauty. Oh, no. Peonia said not to force it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard the story well. Then I'll find out from Peonia.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Hey you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Thank you. For listening to my story. And I'm sorry. I didn't really help you with anything... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? are you okay.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Peonia also listens to the story, but is on guard. Those strong-minded people are trying to kill me. Stupid humans die while fascinated... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks complicated….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's just because I've been through a lot of things.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yeah, you're definitely not an ordinary person...
Hey, there you two. I'm sorry about the story... .
(During a conversation with Beled, when you look in the direction you were talking to, there is a man with a delinquent appearance standing there.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Fixer?

lines.speaker: 해결사
lines.text: That's right. A red-haired woman named Peonia said she would tell you if you talked to the red horned devil over here.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Ah, the object to be subjugated will be over there, towards the inside.

lines.speaker: 해결사
lines.text: Okay, thank you.
(The man called the solver disappears as soon as he hears the answer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that person?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: He's a fixer hired by Mars. There are more monsters and demons than I thought. He said to ask me here.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Half of the time he was shaking or hugging me arbitrarily, but that person was a little different.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Anyway, go to Mars. Give my regards to Chrysien and Peonia. You will find Chrysien as soon as you enter the village.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Take out any demons or monsters that get in your way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Phobos is definitely strange... That fixer doesn't even think it's strange when he sees Beled...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, I don’t know. Gaia sent me for a purpose, so let’s go to a person named Peonia first. Then we’ll find out something.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Hmm, is it because of my mood? Why do I keep having strange thoughts... ? I am… . By the way, that solver gets caught too… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Oh, I don't know.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I… , I am… .
Ugh, I’m sleepy… . I should have gone to bed early. There is a lot of work… .
(A red-haired girl with sleepy eyes is sitting on a bench and yawning. She tries to do something with a needle, thread, and cloth, but then dozes off again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, is that Chrisien?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Yes, that's right, Chrisien.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Beled asked me to say hello to Fionia and Chrysien.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Really? Beled? I guess they asked a passerby to do it since the mayor wouldn't let them come to Mars.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: So… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you there? Why don’t you just talk… .

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Huh, sorry... . I dozed off for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It doesn't hurt anywhere, does it? There was a doctor over there.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Hmm. sorry. Not to that extent. Beled's clothes will have to be repaired someday... . Hmm, things are not good yet... .

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: P.O has a lot of work to do... . By the way, this is my first time seeing you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I came from another area because of work.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Are you a problem solver?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's similar.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Wow, you see. If you come to me later, I will repair your clothes. I'll make you some nice clothes... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This child is dozing off again.)

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: No! I was just thinking about where P.O. would be! My sister will be there if you go straight this way.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: But the problem solver makes a good impression. Most people who come here are rough. The man who passed by earlier was also scared.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Wow, it's noisy when Uncle Baldrick comes and goes... The mayor isn't there either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where has the mayor gone?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: The mayor is a really cool guy, but I can't see if he's been on a business trip lately.  For quite some time… . So my sister is a bit busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is that so? Chrisien, thank you.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Yes… .
(Chrisien is dozing off again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I shouldn't wake him up. You look so tired... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, but Baldrick? I think it's true that the evil king is around here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I need to go to a person named Peonia and find out. I think we'll be able to meet soon, but I don't know yet... .
(In front of a building inside the Avenue de Mars, a red-haired woman is explaining something to people.)
(After hearing the explanation, the rugged men say they understand and move toward Phobos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those people, are they going to solve the problem... ?
Are you a problem solver? Welcome back. This is Mars City. I am Pionia, Mayor Klaus' secretary and butler.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, hey… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Although it is known elsewhere as Phobos, Phobos refers to the entire region.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: It doesn’t matter if you call it Phobos or Mars. After all, this is the land that everyone here loves.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: The goal is to defeat the monsters and demons in Phobos. You will be rewarded according to the number you defeat.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Even if you don't count, a special being on Phobos will count. If you want to quit or the period ends, come report to me.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'll give you money based on the number of people you defeat. Write your name here and sign.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, listen to me.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: First, sign it. I don't have time to listen to the story, so please understand. The solvers leave a bit, so the compensation is pretty good, so if you work hard, you too… .
(Pionia looks at the name %s written on the signature certificate and tilts her head.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: %s… ? That's a name I've heard before somewhere.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Oh, I heard it from Rosemary. A hero.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. Something like a hero... . By the way, is Rosemary here?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: He said he went all the way to Avalon to catch a demigod he didn't like and then ran away. They say they went up the mountain from Lumen.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I really want to imitate you. It would have been nice to have a few more people like that in Mars.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Pretend you haven’t heard this story. So what happened to you, hero? Have you come to meet a superhuman?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's no big deal.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: A hero came, but it was no big deal. It's an obvious lie, but I'll overlook it. What kind of story do you like? Uncle Baldrick?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The mayor... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Let me tell you a story about Uncle Baldrick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…changed words?)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: A man who became a superhuman because he was crazy about fighting, Uncle Baldrick, who has scars and is called the evil king... . When he appears, the entire Phobos area is bound to be noisy.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: That's the same thing with catching monsters. When entering Mars, make sure to leave one or two behind so that the remnants come in groups.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Sigh… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Well, I know he's not a bad person. Because I, Mars City, and the mayor also received help. You saved me from an attack by the Deimos Church. Vice, you bastard... Saying this.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: There are a lot of rumors, but please don't believe them unless you feel it after meeting them. People want to believe it without even experiencing it. The same goes for Beled.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Beled isn't bad. Still, he's a devil, so people should be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Beled….)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I happened to mention Beled's story. If something happens and you go to Phobos, Beled will help you.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Because he is a child who genuinely likes humans. Huh, what did I say... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Ah, what time has it been like this? Sorry, hero. I'm a bit busy. There's a lot of work to do.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: So… . If you want to know anything else, you'll have to ask someone else. At least an outsider's eyes are more accurate than mine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.
(No sooner has he finished speaking than Pionia heads off somewhere with the people who came to see her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess there are circumstances here too... . Well then, shall we go say hello to Rosemary?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: … I wanted to rest, but I had to see a familiar face.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall I go?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: That's it. Come here. Please talk to me for a moment. I was bored.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while. By the way, how long have you been in Mars City?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's okay. I happened to go into Avalon and got kicked out, so I decided to take a break here... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I want to go back to Freios, but I can't. You have a curious expression. What do you want to know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I try to talk to Peonia about the mayor, it seems like she's diverting the conversation.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Yeah? Well, I don't know the details, but I'll explain what I know.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You know the evil king, right? Not a vicious king, but a man who became a superman because he was crazy about battle. I come to the Phobos area every year.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I thought it would be good for Mayor Klaus to become friends with a superhuman, so we sparred, and Baldrick got excited and went wild. Baldrick is excited, but Mayor Klaus must be dying.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Mayor Klaus disappeared when Baldrick arrived.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Additionally, a large number of demons appeared in the Phobos area. There are more monsters... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Shall we summarize?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Baldrick appears, and the mayor disappears. And it's definitely not a coincidence that demons and monsters that want to attack this land have appeared, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Beled?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Beled?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Although the devil named Beled is a bit interesting, the timing is different from when Mayor Klaus disappeared. He said he came here a long time ago.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It is said that he fell in love with Peonia and courted her for a while, but Peonia flatly rejected her.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: The residents were afraid and told me not to enter the city, so they just looked at this place. They said they would wait though... ..

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'm a pure fan of the devil... . And the incubus... . Normally, I would have destroyed it already, but I stopped because Peonia was stopping me.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: But that guy is strange. It seems like he's destroying other demons of his own kind and doing whatever the mayor tells him to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If we find Baldrick, will we be able to find out about the market?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You don't know that. Let’s go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Do whatever you want. Peonia said she wanted to clear up Baldrick's misunderstanding, so why not do that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chrysien and Peonia both view Baldrick favorably.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Baldrick stays at a place called Cradle every year, so go there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: And I was going to deliver a message to Beled on Peonia's behalf, but it's a hassle, so please do it for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it about?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's not a big deal, just say thank you and you'll understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will go to Beled before I go to the cradle. What will Rosemary do from here?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Me? Well, I have to go to work. I'm just here for a moment... .

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I will contact you separately when I meet the Demigods.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wow, this is annoying. Why do I keep up with those people... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Rosemary.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a Demigod….)
You found it, my doll.
(The image of a boy appears in front of Beled and stretches out his hand. The image is just a shape, and the hand does not reach Beled. However, the voice continues to be directed at Beled.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Who are you? Incubus?
We will meet soon, doll. soon… .
(The figure of someone in front of Beled disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's gone.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Why does a devil I've never met call me a doll? It may be a beautiful piece, but it is a doll... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Whether it’s a doll or a sculpture, why is it such a beautiful day? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Are you here? I just stayed. Oh, let me ask you one thing. You. Do I look like a piece? Does it look like a doll?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is a sculpture and what is a doll?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Someone told me I was a doll. Even if there were beautiful dolls in the world, they couldn't compare to me... . What on earth?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: But what happened? Do you want to get a lecture about beauty from me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will decline any lectures or anything like that. Now I have come to spread the words of Peonia.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Huh?
(Beled’s eyes sparkle with a sour expression when he hears the word “Pionia.”)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What? Say it again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm here to spread the words of Peonia.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What did Peonia say?! Come on, tell me! I want you to hear it in my ears!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is why it’s so scary….)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Come on, come on!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Nothing else, just thank you. If you say that, Beled will know.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Peonia!! Thank you too!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's definitely a unique demon.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: %s, thank you for conveying Peonia’s message. I want to do something... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Now, wait… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Can you feel it? This energy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, this is definitely... .
(No sooner has he finished speaking than darkness mixed with an unknown ominous energy rushes into Phobos.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's annoying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled, do you know what happened?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: A devil who uses a lot of power has openly revealed his presence. Is there something you are aiming for? .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Ugh… .
(Suddenly, Beled clutches his chest and falls down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I think it's okay. Why am I like this... .Suddenly I feel afraid… . I've never been like this before... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Even when a corps commander-level demon appears, I have never been like this. What on earth happened... . ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In an instant, Beled’s expression changed. I think he remembered something…)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Then you are on your way. I need to get some rest. I suddenly got tired.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, I will.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Go and clear up the misunderstanding of the human being called Baldrick. Since this is what Peonia wants, it would be better for you to do it rather than me, the devil.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The cradle where that person stays is over there. And be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You'll find out when you go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But what does it mean to be careful, and what does it mean to know when you go…?)

steps.name: Master's Cradle
steps.objective: Defeat [Lilith] in “Cradle of Illusions” and report to [Baldrick] in “Phobos”.

lines.text: (The moment you try to approach the place that is thought to be the cradle of illusion, a huge force comes flying at %s from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it? That's incredibly fast... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't feel it. What is it? What kind of power is this... If I were hit like this, I would definitely die...)
It was you after all.
(The dust disappears and a huge red-haired man stands before my eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are Baldrick, right? The evil king… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Yes, I'm Baldrick. Ahahaha!!  Nice to meet you!! I heard the story. No, I found out. Whatever it is, I'm happy! Ahahaha.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I don't like being uncomfortable, so please call me comfortably.
(Baldrick grins and holds out his hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Baldrick. Nice to meet you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s an incredible grip. I only hold it lightly, but I can feel the tremendous strength.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: A normal person would have sensed my strength and run away, but I held on well!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I've never seen you, but somehow I'm glad to see you? You know a little about it too, right? It means you find out things you don't really want to know right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's annoying so I throw it away as soon as I find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a good method. I already came to see Baldrick, but I see him here.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Peonia is worried about Baldrick. The residents say they misunderstand.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That kid always does that. Stop nagging me, but it's still like that. Besides, why is he so busy that he doesn't even get a break?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Not long ago, there was even an annoying devil attached to it. I tried to scold him, but he told me not to touch him again. He is truly a hard-working child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You know that Klaus is gone, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are people who wonder what Baldrick did, so I came to clear up the misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Huh, really? If you're scared of me, you might think so. I'm used to misunderstandings... . Now I'm looking for Klaus too. I'm sure it's around here, but it's not there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I really don't care.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: By the way, did you feel it too? There's a crazy evil force hovering around here... . It is probably the force that leads the demons who flock to Phobos.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: So, you come to the crib with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's a cradle... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This is the village where the teacher’s remains are located. But now it's just a ruin... . Do you feel the power of the devil in front of you?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I don't know why!! I think there is a strong one!! I think I can find Klaus too!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Baldrick looks happy...)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, you get it, right? Because power is meant to be used in times like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Power….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick, come with me.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Great! Let’s go straight to the Cradle of Hwan!
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Baldrick runs into the cradle of illusions. The speed is so fast that it seems impossible to catch up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He asked me to go with him... . Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall we go?
(In the deepest part of the Cradle of Illusions, Baldrick is rejoicing as he repels an attack from a being with a grotesque appearance.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Wow, are you really strong? It's different from the demons I've met so far! It just got fun!
A shallow person obsessed with fighting... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Do you think I would respond to such a provocation? Hahaha, then it will live up to your expectations. If you were a teacher, how would you have caught you?
He's a muscle idiot, but he's a human being blessed by God, so I can't read his thoughts!! Even charm doesn’t work!! I'm dying of frustration.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Amazing rose scent... .
That to a noble and beautiful dream horse... . Oh, come to think of it, you!  It's that human. You can't get out of here. Because I will destroy it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you? You sound like you know me.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: I am Lilith. I will prick your heart with a thorn and make a rose grow. I judge you for killing my love... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's noisy during battle. Ha!
(Baldrick's powerful attack causes a huge vortex to fill the space.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Why are you here now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Hey, Baldrick. I took the shortcut alone and, not knowing the way, I took care of all the monsters and demons!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, sorry, sorry. I'll buy you food later. Would free ring curry be enough? Hey, you! be careful!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
(Something sparkles and flies out of the thick dust. In a split second, Baldrick runs in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bye, Baldrick!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick!!

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: I thought you were a person who was only crazy about fighting, but I guess there is also acceptance?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Beings called superhumans have an inner affinity with this guy. It felt like we were friends even when we first saw each other.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You… , They say they are noble devils, but they fight shamelessly. Seeing how he threw dozens of them pretending to be just one, in case he didn't die in one hit... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This hurts pretty bad. It's been a long time since I was dealt a blow by Vice... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick, are you okay? wound… .
(There is a huge thorn stuck in Baldrick's stomach.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Of course it's not okay. Unlike the little boy, he might die, but he won't die, so don't be scared and solve it quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. But if you're a kid... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: During that time, attack that dream demon one more time. I'll be treating you for a moment, so just wait. Ha!
(As Baldrick shouts his courage, the thorn stuck in his stomach falls off. Blood flows continuously through the wound.)

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Stupid human… . He was bluffing with an expression as if he was about to die... . Well, that's enough.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Degos. It's time. I will kill the person who made you disappear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Degos… ?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: The embodiment of rage I loved. He was really beautiful. I was so taken by its beauty that I abandoned Asmodea and followed her, but you killed her.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: The world without that beautiful person was truly painful. Asmodea made my body like this because I didn't follow her.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: They told me to become the person I love!! To turn a beautiful day into a monster like this... .

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: How can he be jealous that I don't love him, even though he is loved by many demons... . Yes, I am beautiful.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: I came over Rosengarten to meet you as soon as the door opened. If I defeat you, Asmodea will approve.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That dream demon, you are mistaken. Degos did not disappear. They said it would definitely come back, but do you not know the news?)

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: You should really see my beautiful appearance. Only then, Degos… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn't matter whether I misunderstand or not. The enemy is in front of me anyway...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lilith, you. If you're on the same side as Degos, then of course you know what kind of person I am, right?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. I will do the same to you as I did to those who tried to harm life.
(With those words, Lilith’s eyes, which were burning red, become filled with dark energy.)

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: I'll look forward to it. At least I won't end up like Degos!!

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: I, I... . I can't defeat this person... . Degos… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will admit that you are as strong as Degoth.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: He, he... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But to me, you and Degos are just the same devil. Harmful to this world... .

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Don't think they're the same! I am a pure devil, he is a human turned devil... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said he loved Degos, so he shared his origins and hoped it wouldn't end up like that. A contradictory devil who speaks of love... .

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: That, that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is love nonsense?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: What I love is not a lie. No, you're weirder than that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's weird about me? Just answer my questions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is the love that Mongma talks about really true? Aren’t you mistaken because of your abilities?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's just one hit and it's over, why am I hesitating?)
(Lilith's expression changes as she notices something. Instead of being a beautiful dream horse, she looks like a monster like something you would see at the end of hell.)
(But, that’s only for a moment. A hot and huge force flies towards Lilith from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Yes, it's Baldric the Evil King.
(Baldrick approaches with a bright expression and taps %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Why are you so hesitant?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Ah, something like that. Then leave the finishing touches to me. Because this suits me more than you.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: By the way, what was your name? Come to think of it, I didn't ask your name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: %s…  no see.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Yes, %s.
(Baldrick smiles when he hears %s's name. With that smile, Lilith begins to tremble as if she felt something.)

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Save me... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Are you Lily? Release? Ah, it's annoying. Okay, you devil, if you answer my question correctly, I'll think about it.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Yes, as much as you want… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Have you seen Klaus? He's about as tall as me and has an impressive smile. Early to mid 40s, blonde hair and blue eyes.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: That guy. Well, I went there. Oh, Rosengarten... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Where is it?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Hey, it's the demon world.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Demon world? How do humans go to the demon world?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Well, it's connected to Rosengarten and some place in Phobos. I don't know anymore. I don't know. This is enough now, right? Save me... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: %s, please wait a moment, I have some business to do with this devil. Close your eyes for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I sense great madness from Baldrick... I have to do what I'm told for now.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: %s… , he’s a good guy. What about you, Lily…? . Oh, just the devil. Do you know why people call me the evil king?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Well, how do I know that?! An insignificant human nickname?!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I don't know, because noble demons have no interest in petty humans.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Then I'll let you know. I make even the devil tremble... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Because he is the king of all evil in the world!!!!!!
(As Baldrick's crazy voice disappears, a huge force passes by at high speed on both sides of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lilith is gone. No, it's gone. I can't even scream... . It seems like Baldrick only gathered his strength to attack once... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. Ugh, dust… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where has Baldrick gone again?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Here it is.
(Baldrick, covered in dust, jumps from somewhere and lands in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let's go out first. Let's go out and talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: … At this rate, it wasn't as wild as I thought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: More than you think?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This is my teacher's hometown, so I just did it in moderation. I'm restoring it as time allows, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: If you don't die anyway, you have plenty of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person was your teacher?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: He was a good person. Now that I think about it, it’s been so long. I helped the weak until the end. Then he died.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I wanted revenge, but my teacher probably wouldn't have wanted it. The guy who killed his teacher probably grew old and died of his own accord.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What's unfortunate is that I didn't get to see the last of my teachers. When I returned after hearing the news that he had died, only the memorial tablet remained in the shrine. It is said that the bones were scattered in Deborah in a place overlooking the sea... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Next time you meet people from a country called ‘Jin’, ask them. A female fighter named ‘Hwan’ will answer what kind of existence she is to them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. When I heard his name, I thought it was a man.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Right? I thought so too at first. Ah, let's stop talking about the teacher.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Did you hear that Klaus went to a place called Rosengarten?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. They say it's connected to Phobos somewhere... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Where on earth is that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How about asking about that?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'll have to look it up sometime.
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Baldrick runs towards somewhere in Phobos. The speed is so fast that it seems impossible to catch up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, Baldrick… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was going to ask Beled, who said he was from Rosengarten, to go ask... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like you have a hard time hearing what other people are saying. I can't help it. I have no choice but to go alone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But, I was like that again. I didn’t seem to be myself… Baldrick, even the devil knew.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But… , this energy… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel an unknown energy coming from the direction where Beled was...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I don't know. First, let's go to Beled.

steps.name: Rose of Enchantment
steps.objective: Defeat [Asmodea] in “Rosengarten” and obtain <Red Rose Pendant>. Then report to [Beled] in “Phobos”.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: %s, don't come near... .
(Beled has a distorted expression and is covering one eye.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Stop… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is the power of the devil. Similar to when I met Degos and Malphas... But I didn't feel this power at first.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm sorry. I have no choice but to be like this now. So don’t come closer!! Well, I can barely hold it in!!

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: So this isn't what I wanted... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Go to Rosengarten quickly!! I can tolerate it to some extent as long as you go to Rosengarten. You have to be patient!!
(Blood begins to flow from Beled's eyes as he screams.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Well, Rosen Garten is connected to a well that was once used by the people of Phobos. Since the rose vines and rose leaves have fallen, you will be able to find them quickly... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Go and bring me the decoration on this necklace. otherwise… . I might end up killing Peonia with my own hands... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I am me. They say he is my master... . I am… . I am… .
(Beled’s body is stiffening before he can even finish speaking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled… .
Maybe I should have just left it alone. Bring back the souls of the humans here... .  He's going to come back anyway... .
(A voice similar to Beled’s is heard from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is definitely... the voice of the person I saw before coming to Phobos...)
(The person behind the voice then appears blurry.)
Dolls are really noisy. There was no need to explain it to a mere human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Obviously you... .
I can be seen by the human there. Were you watching me back then? Looking into the realm of the demon world, I see that you have a lot of courage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
What a spoiled human being. It is polite to introduce yourself first. Well, that's it. Because I already know.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I am ‘Asmodea’, the owner of Rosengarten and the ruler of the dream demons. If you've met Lilith, you definitely know my name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Asmodea.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: It was a good idea to place Lilith in an area where there are powerful people. I checked carefully to see how much power I had.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lilith wasn't there willingly.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: She's a dreamer anyway. It was just that I, the ruler of the dream demon, fell under the spell. So I guess they thought he went on his own.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: A normal human being would have already fallen under my spell and come to sacrifice their soul, but it's nothing... . That's interesting. It's enough to shake my heart...
(Asmodea smiles and stretches out her hand. A rose blooms from the tip of her finger.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: We are officially invited to ‘Rosengarten’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This strong rose scent… It’s over there…)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Come find me. And give your soul to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if you refuse?

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: You won't even be able to say no.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: If you don't come, more demons and monsters will head to Phobos than now.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: You wouldn't want that, would you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's like a devil... .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Take it as a compliment. In any case, the way of thinking in the Demon World is different from that of you humans.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I will be looking forward and waiting. Even as a devil, meeting a good soul with strong power is something close to luck.
(When Asmodea smiles again, the rose in his hand turns to ashes. The ashes blow away in the wind from somewhere, and he can no longer be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's too loud for an invitation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … At a time like this, it would have been okay if I had heard His Majesty the Sylvaria Emperor's prophecy that I would solve everything... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go first... .
(Bright light comes in between the dark spaces.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Rosengarten… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's so beautiful that you can't see it in real life. A garden full of roses in beautiful sunlight... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's like a nobleman's mansion... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This is the Demon World. Come now, brother?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, what a surprise. Baldrick, when did you come?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Just now. I finally found it. here… The scent of roses is strong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what about you?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Since we work together on matters related to life and death, we can already be considered brothers. I call you ‘Aunnim’ regardless of gender.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if I told you not to call me that, I think you would just call me that.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Jiscard's brother also gave up. I did it by drinking a lot of alcohol instead... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you perhaps forgotten my name?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, don't worry about that. Brother.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Obviously I forgot. Oh, I care….)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Then, brother. Talk to me. I think I came for a purpose other than Klaus... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Baldrick what happened to Beled.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I see. It got pretty complicated.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick, what are you going to do? There are two paths... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Did you think the same thing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I will go left, you go right. Oh, if you find Klaus on the way, act together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, I don’t know what Mayor Klaus looks like.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: He has red hair, blue eyes, is about as tall as me, and is handsome anyway. If something happens, you'll be recognized right away because he's wearing armor with a gold chain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then I'll look for it as I go.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Good luck, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Baldrick. uh? You called my name. What, you're already gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, then let’s get started.
(A dead end alley in the rose garden, in front of which Asmodea is sitting in front of a luxurious-looking table.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Please wait a moment. Tea time has just started, so let's have some fun and then talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You call a guest and make him wait.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Oh, sir? Did I invite you? In that case, I will gladly offer you a drink as well.
(Asmodea pours tea into an empty teacup.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought there was something in the car... .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: A rose took root and grew using the residue of the soul, and its first leaf was touched by a beautiful succubus.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: The leaves will make you want to stay in Rosengarten when you drink this tea.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: It's a specialty that other demons also want to drink.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is something I want to know.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Then sit down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard Mayor Klaus came in here.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Klaus? Is he Klaus? There's no need to remember the human's name, but that sounds like it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are you now?

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: It was a pretty good soul, but it was a soul better suited for a greedy demon like Einhorn to devour than me.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: If you still want to get an answer, go talk to Einhorn. Maybe his voice will come out from the devil's mouth... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… … .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Maybe your brother destroyed it... .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Greed is big and grows without end. The person called the mayor did not deviate much. So I set foot in Rosengarten.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Looks like you made a good deal with Vice's messenger. The man offered good conditions for his wish. All life on Phobos and Mars... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And here's the vise... . And why is Mayor Klaus… .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Klaus? That person was that kind of person. It’s worse than the Deimos Church’s magic stone made with the power of life… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you trying to do with that magic stone? Why do you want a doll made of magic stones?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You definitely called Beled a doll.
(For a moment, Asmodea's expression darkens. The feeling of smiling and showing composure is gone.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: You've heard that far.
(Rosengarten, which was full of bright light, becomes dark, and a devil-like being appears above Asmodea.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: A long time ago, there was a twisted person who was followed by a certain life. It is called ‘Phobos’. This is a part of him, this demon god friend will join me to fight you.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I'll leave the useless explanation here. Human… .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Be the nourishment that fills my deficiency with my doll. The goddess' errand boy... . Sigh.
(After a short silence, blood slowly flows out of Asmodea's mouth.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: This can't be... . Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: The demon 'Phobos' disappears... . Although it is partially Phobos, the twin brother of Deimos... .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Cluck, cluck.
(Asmodea coughs up blood and collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looking at what you said about deficiency and strength, it seems that your soul is imperfect. If you look at what they tried to fill with the doll and me... .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Cluck, cluck… . I won't deny it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just answer one.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: It's about vise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Nothing much… .  Cluck cluck.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I just decided to respond to his summons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is the cost of summoning a demon a magic stone?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A demon who wants a magic stone created by gathering the power of life... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh?! Is that so?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something wrong with your strength. So, I have to fill my strength in other ways.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look like you don't want to admit it.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: In the demon world, if a demon is weak, it is immediately swallowed up. In order to live... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you made a deal because you had no choice but to survive?

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I can't fall down like this. Fill the deficiency, go beyond Rosengarten and reach Pandemonium... . And Degoth and Lux... .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Yes, ugh, keaaaa!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?
(Rosengarten shakes due to Asmodea's struggles. And a hole is created through which Phobos and Mars City can be seen at first glance.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Rosengarten. It's okay to give up beauty. Swallow Phobos!! Swallow all the souls of Phobos and make them reach me!!
(With Asmodea's words, the roses in Rosengarten suddenly wither. They rot and begin to emit a strange scent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This, this… .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I can't bear to see Rosengarten throw away beauty, but if only my lack could be filled!!

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Ugh… . My, my body… .How dare you, a doll made of my power and magic stones... ..

lines.speaker: 벨레드의 목소리
lines.text: (Asmodea, the fact that you can destroy me means that I can do the same to you...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled? I feel like I can hear it all over Rosengarten, what is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Asmodea's body stiffens... .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Weiss, I won't forgive you... .
(Asmodea, whose entire body was frozen and unable to move, suddenly bursts into flames from the fingertips.)
(After a while, the beautiful devil turns into ashes and scatters in the wind. And a rose-shaped pendant falls underneath it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this what Beled wanted? Then, everything here is over, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . First, let’s find Baldrick… . uh?

choices.text: 1. I feel like I’m popular somewhere.

lines.text: I was waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you… ?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I don't know if you know it, but it is said to be Baral, who was under the inspiration. Anyway, the effect of the Spirit King’s medicine is good. Seeing how stupid you were.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral? Pfft… . When will it attack... .

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I made four attacks, and you didn't even notice one.
(As soon as the words are finished, the hook wrapped around Baral's hand is pointed at %s. However, a huge shock wave occurs and he is lightly thrown away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Baldrick… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: My brother is getting some rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, I can’t get up from one word from Baldrick….)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: The most annoying person has appeared.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Baral, your opponent would be me.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: It's the same with Vice, but superhumans learn a lot of useless information. The power of God, so everyone wants to become a superman, right?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Baral, you tried to kill me and turn Klaus into a superhuman, right? No, were you trying to use Klaus as bait to kill me?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: That's right. After hanging out with you a few times, it became quite plausible.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Klaus... .

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Asmodea's demon ate it and you, stupid, destroyed it. Even a kid gets involved in it. Very funny.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mayor Klaus….)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I don't feel like listening to Weiss, but I guess I'll have to do this. I'm coming, idiot.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Stop, Baral!

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Do you think I will stay still if I tell you to stop? A frustrating guy… . It's annoying, but I'll tell you one thing in particular.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: If things continue like this, you'll all be sucked into a gap in time and space. Then I'm really leaving. If you want to see me later, let's meet at Avalon.
(As soon as Baral turns his back, his image disappears like an illusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That guy named Baral… It feels similar to Vice. And I’ll see you in Avalon. What on earth is that black hole…)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This is not the time to be admiring, brother. This black hole wasn't made by the devil. It's a hole created by a split in space and time. It's getting bigger so you have to get out quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Brother, you have a red rose decoration in your hand. Are you going to give it to the devil kid who follows Peonia around?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Beled asked me to bring it to you.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Then let's go! Hold on tight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does it mean to hold on tightly?
(Baldrick lifts Adventurer with one hand and places it on his shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(Baldrick grins and runs like crazy towards the black hole in front of him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah, Vaaaldrriiick!!
(Pionia looks forlornly at Beled, who is standing frozen.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Beled… ?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Why aren't you saying anything? Why are you standing like that?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: The demons that were hanging out in front of Mars City disappeared, so I was wondering if something had happened to Beled... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Beled… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'm sorry for making it like this... . It's my fault. I should have looked a little closer... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Arrived!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I barely survived.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Uncle Baldrick? %s? Why here... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Peonia, it’s been a while. My brother said he had something to deliver to Beled.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Are you my brother?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: If you've been together in life and death, you're already like brothers.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a bit complicated... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Tell me, %s. It wouldn't be normal if you were with Uncle Baldrick, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Peonia briefly what happened in Phobos.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: That was the reason the mayor disappeared. I just thought there was something there, but the moment I found this on the mayor's desk and heard %s's story... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. The magic stone of the Deimos Church... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: On behalf of the residents of Mars City, I want to say thank you. Thank you too, Uncle Baldrick.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I will take care of the mayor's affairs properly. It might be a bit difficult to convince the residents... . Uncle, I will definitely clear up any misunderstandings about Uncle Baldrick.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: And… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled will be fine.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because it was Beled who saved me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come on, Beled. As promised, I brought you a red rose pendant.
(A pendant rises from the tips of %s's fingers and heads toward Beled. The moment the pendant touches his chest, anything blocking him shatters.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This guy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick, be quiet now.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Yeah. I get it.
(Beled’s eyes begin to move as if stopped time is flowing again.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Ah… … .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Is it over?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Are you really okay? Can you see me?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yeah, I'm fine. And thank you. I heard it all... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: It's okay, it's okay. So is it really okay?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yeah. are you okay. Am I not the devil anymore? Wasn’t it like that from the beginning? Still the devil... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Whether you're a devil or something, you... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It’s complicated… .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Is this really okay?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yeah. and… .
(Beled’s gaze turns to Adventurer and Baldrick.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Okay. I guess I have something to talk about with you two. Then I… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll wait. Because I've always been like that... .

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Okay… . Then I'll return to Mars.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: %s, thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: And Uncle Baldrick. I'll cook you something delicious, so you must come. sorry.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'm sorry... . Done. You're not like that... . ha ha ha. Then go carefully.
(Baldrick waves his hand until Peonia disappears. When Peonia is no longer visible, Beled quietly approaches.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You two, I have a place to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not a dangerous place, right?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I just have something to show you. Baldrick, let's go too.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I don't think I need to see anything, but I'll follow along anyway.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Okay.
(The moment Beled grabs the hands of Baldrick and %s, the scenery in his field of vision changes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .
(Asmodea's voice is heard in the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: A doll that resembles me made of magic stones, if you have this, you can fill me up.
(There is a being similar to Beled in front of Asmodea.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: You will be me, so I will name you myself. Beled, yes. You'd like Beled. It is the name of the great person who pioneered Rosengarten.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I don't feel like going against those who are targeting Rosengarten, but I have no choice.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: This was the first time I knew that demons also had souls. And that the soul also has deficiencies.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: It's funny that you're so scared that other demons will find out... .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I commend you for opening a gap in space and time to come to Rosengarten.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I have a question. You have power comparable to that of the leader of Agashura and the power left behind by the Old Gods. What happened?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: It just so happened… . So it happened. Maybe I can overcome those chasing me... .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: He is an interesting man. Anyway, can I just take over the Demon World and respond to your summons?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: You who want to bring down Deimos, and I who have a part of his brother Phobos. This meeting will never be a coincidence.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: That's what he wants. Also, this is what I hope for.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Although it's a little different, I think it's because there's something in common.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: One last word. I hope your doll made of magic stone doesn't wake up somewhere else.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The spiritual power of life on this earth is strong.  Something else was created with the magic stone created in that way, and other powers were mixed in... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Something may happen that you don't think about.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I'm curious to hear that story. However, Beled will never wake up anywhere other than here.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Did you go? It's quite interesting that a human is speaking the language of the devil.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Like this, I will wait for my doll to wake up. and… .

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I will never send it anywhere else.
(Asmodea and Rosengarten where he was no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled, this is… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Some of my memories belong to Asmodea. So Asmodea wasn't visible at all.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The person I am now is neither a doll nor a devil. That doesn't mean they're human either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's okay right now, but I don't think it will be okay after a while.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I fell here because of a black hole, and I wanted to know how I came to like Peonia when I saw it for the first time... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I want to stand properly in front of Peonia. Maybe there is a way!
(Beled smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I don't know what it is, but you're a cool guy. I want to call you brother.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll decline that.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'll talk to Peonia nicely. You know it when you see it, right? Peonia tends to listen to me well though.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's tempting, but I still don't want to call him brother.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Is it just me singing?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Okay then.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Yes, Brother Beled. Because there is nothing better than having a special younger sibling. Isn't it? %s Brother?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Doesn’t it hurt anymore?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, now that I think about it… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's not a big deal, but I shared my strength for you. This will give strength to the girl who has become a new god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Baldrick! Iris will be delighted!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Goddess… Should I call it that? I believe that when the Goddess gains more strength, she will help us defeat Vice.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Until then, I will improve my skills even more. I haven't gotten my revenge on Weiss yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Well, thanks to you, I have a goal to live by... . Oh, I'm going to rest for a bit and go look for Baral.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: When you get back, tell your brother Jiscard. If I told you to do it, you wouldn't say anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: And I'll be staying in the teacher's village for the time being, so come and see me if you want to spar. I'm not the same as I used to be, but I can do it for three days and three nights!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Oh, I'll decline.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beled. Baldrick. Then I'll go. I think I should tell the person who sent me here that things were resolved well.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's Gaia... . What do you look like this time? 200 years ago, I saw him once in Gerda, and I was surprised at how similar he was to my teacher.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: But isn’t it time to go back to sleep? Isn't it? Well, I hope you are well. Say hello when you see me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Beled is also doing well.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes, %s, tell Adkina thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should we take a quick look at Minuet before going to the Valley of the Dragon? Maybe we'll see Gaia again...)
(Beled smiles brightly and waves his hand until %s's figure disappears from Phobos.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Hey, Baldrick.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Why, brother?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What are you going to tell Peonia?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: The cool guy who protects Phobos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?
(No matter how much I sing, the minuet does not respond.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?! minuet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has something happened to Gaia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s ask Adkina… I’m sure there’s something going on, right?)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Welcome, %s. I was waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, then… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I know what you're worried about. The time has come for Gaia to go somewhere else.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Realizing that it wasn't long before he could fall asleep, he headed to the 'Sanctuary of the Covenant'.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it is the sanctuary of the covenant... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A sacred place where those who receive oracles swear to God... , I'm not sure where it is, but it will appear in front of you when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, I feel like I can go there soon...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then what happens to the minuet?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The minuet is fine. Because I'm just falling asleep like usual.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I thought something was up.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You might think so. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah, thank you for Beled’s work. I just thought he would help you, I didn't think about anything else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, how do I do that... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I think I got to know Baldrick better now that he was with you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Now I'm going to go out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I will follow Weiss's footsteps on the continent beyond Adrica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina, then what about the phantom beasts and Adrika?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Medea decided to watch over me for the time being. It is said that Shinik buys a lot of food for the phantom beasts from Luman and gives them enough food so that they do not die.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Now, the earth has been purified to the point that anyone who deems it righteous can enter. Mr. Jiscard and Ms. Io said they would help if anything happened, so they should be okay for the time being.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not just Baldrick.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Because Baldrick is so special.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I know very well what you are worried about.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: However, now that I know that Weiss is preparing to descend on Deimos, I have to fight back just like before.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The life of the ancient Pluton Dragon saved by Ceres and Gaia. Now it's my turn to repay the favor.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's okay. I received permission from Gaia. I ended up being disrespectful to the one who commanded me to protect this land... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I can't leave the fate of this world to you alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I rested here today. There are many things prepared for you. The phantom beasts will also be happy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will take a rest without paying attention. I was hungry... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Wow, it’s a party! party! I'm going to eat it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, why is Mir there?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ahaha… . It's time for me to move.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If Mir came... . maybe… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ahaha. Ahaha… . ah… . that is… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Actually, I was wondering how far I should go to find Adventurer, but I'm glad I ended up here.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Here's something for you.
(Mir takes out a letter from his pocket and delivers it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An edict from His Majesty, the Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Please open it in front of Adkina at the exact time written here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a similar situation to last time…. A situation that was already predicted….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Hey Adkina. Can I take care of you until then?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm fine anytime, so do what's convenient for you. Don't think about anything today and just enjoy it. I'm sure Gaia wants it too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then, can I take a walk in the Valley of the Dragon for a moment? I have something to think about... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That's right. By the time you return, there will be food prepared that both humans and phantom beasts will like.
(While Adventurer is away for a moment, Mir looks at Adkina quietly.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adkina, Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Mir, he will be fine. It should be okay.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If there is someone who makes him unhappy, the owner of the earth, the moon, flowers, and plants will not leave him alone. Of course, I won't stay still either.
